title: Check curriculum records against the framework
statement: Before adopting or generating from curriculum sources, compare candidates item by item on content and check their facts and labels against the official framework, because derived copies shift labels.
example: An audit of 30 records against the published framework found 6 (20%) paired with an objective from a neighbouring topic.
detail: A model compared 30 records from a curriculum service with the published course framework and found 6/30 (20%) of objectives taken from a neighbouring topic. Later, items for topics whose period and content disagreed could not satisfy the judge's chronology check, and a cross-check named that mismatch as the root cause. One such topic had been tagged unit=1 by a processing step that mis-mapped a Unit 2 standard; the upstream curriculum was right. Do the check course by course and record the version of the framework checked against.
against: The same 30-record audit, itself a model's comparison with the framework, found no topic in the wrong period: "- **Off-by-period drift (the InceptBench APEURO disease):** **ZERO instances detected.**" (icloud-work/aptraining/workspace/comms/_deprecated/outboxes/from_atlas/2026-04-28T1500Z_api_vs_cb_ced_verdict.md, 15). A date-only screen over-flags: "**12 of the 18 "flagged" are false-positives** (date range starts pre-1607; remap was wrong call by date-only heuristic)." (icloud-work/aptraining/workspace/comms/from_data/2026-05-28T1549Z_u1_kc_audit_report.md, 95) The audit called it a single-record fix and not a systemic issue (`icloud-work/auto-memory-backup/project_grader_audit_results_2_of_3_pass.md`, line 63), and what it did to items built from that record is not in this evidence. The period sweep's suggestions are best-effort and need review before any data change (icloud-work/aptraining/helpers/data/output/curriculum_kc_period_audit.md, line 69). The shifted labels did not reach the curriculum service used for generation, which an audit found free of the shift (`MEMORY.md`, line 82). The fixes were still open at a later handover (`project_oracle_session_20260501.md`, lines 22 and 24), and no effect on generated items was measured.

evidence.quote: - **Real systematic drift:** **`lo_drift` in 6/30 (20%)** — the API attaches a Learning Objective from a neighboring topic / LO, not the LO that CB CED actually pairs with that KC.

**Root cause of the bug**: inceptbench's KC-derivation pipeline mis-mapped this upstream U2 substandard to its `c_Qbro` short code and tagged it `unit=1` during processing. The bug is in the inceptbench-side conversion script, not in upstream curriculum.
Period mismatch is the root cause — v80b can't satisfy chronology guardrail when the KC's period and content disagree.
- **Off-by-period drift (the InceptBench APEURO disease):** **ZERO instances detected.**
**12 of the 18 "flagged" are false-positives** (date range starts pre-1607; remap was wrong call by date-only heuristic).

**APUSH** = MERGE (curriculum repo skeleton + InceptBench atomic facts; 39% / 99.8% non-overlap means single-source halves pedagogy). Wrong source per course = silent training corruption.
